question: There's an order on my account I never placed. Fix this now.
answer:
This has been escalated to our security team for review. In the meantime:

- Please change your password and enable 2FA on your account as soon as possible.
- Avoid sharing any account details or one-time codes with anyone claiming to be Sezzle support.
- A human agent will follow up to investigate the order and take appropriate action (which may include removing liability for unauthorized charges).

Is there anything else I can help with while that's in progress?
